decisions: Effects are represented initially as EffectDefinition ScriptableObjects with a JSON payload string to avoid premature polymorphic typing.
Enums (Rarity, CardType, SlotType) created to match schema enums.
Skill node effects use a descriptive string placeholder; can be migrated to EffectDefinition later.
Placed files under Assets/Scripts/DataModels following plan recommendation; tests under Assets/Tests/Editor.
All helper additions are minimal and limited to EffectDefinition and a few small serializable classes.
